channel.title: Bro's in Control
channel.desc: The bros become superheroes and even learn to fly as they take to the skies - strapped to a plane! West End superstar Hannah Lowther joins Joe for a sock puppet musical, while Adam makes his very own 'sockumentary' - but only one will face the Wheel of Doom and a terrifying ride in the dark.
